opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only. University Development Office should coordinate applications.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research infrastructure, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) that help pupils at secondary level develop skills for employment or independent living. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) helping people with disabilities live more independently, particularly projects focused on training, employment and supported housing, including transitions from children's to adults' services. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focused on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, operated by a registered charity or local authority, open and accessible to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, operated by a registered charity or local authority, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, open and accessible to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Museums and galleries operated by a registered charity or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Performing arts organisations operated by a registered charity or a local authority, focused on professional performance, able to make a case for the significance of their education work. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishment of these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections, operated by a registered charity, local authority or university, displaying collections of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process.
